The scores indicate a moderate level of confidence in this interaction pathway, suggesting that the compound may modulate the activity of phosphodiesterase 6C, thereby influencing the function of Casein kinase II subunit beta. The mechanism involves a cascade of enzymatic interactions, where the compound acts as a modulator of the downstream target. However, the strength of the evidence is moderate, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct interaction between 2,7,7-Trimethylbicyclo[2.2.1]heptan-2-ol and the Casein kinase II subunit beta.
